purpose: Prepare a post-closeout primary held-out HDEV-100 headroom diagnostic and a separate descriptive Train-250 comparison.

required_runtime_bindings.a2_closeout_receipt: valid PASS_A2_EXECUTION_CLOSEOUT measured_development_aggregate A2 closeout with exact 52/40/12 coverage, five winner receipt hashes, terminal checkpoint, safe return, workers reaped, and protected scan PASS
required_runtime_bindings.a2_winners: exactly five frozen winner program SHA-256 values with one valid aggregate-only Train-250 receipt per arm
required_runtime_bindings.a1_incumbent_aggregate_receipt: valid frozen PASS aggregate receipt with one Recall@100 OUT value per arm

post_closeout_hdev100_boundary: A separately emitted self-hashed authorization may bind the five frozen A2 winners and A1 incumbents for one non-adaptive HDEV-100 aggregate-only evaluation. The repository contains no protected-data or retrieval runner.
output_boundary: The primary HDEV-100 result and secondary Train-250 comparison emit aggregate-only winner-minus-incumbent Recall@100 OUT deltas; neither can promote, select, or execute a candidate.
